description_en: Modifies the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) settings of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) device
description_zh: 修改智能接入网关设备动态路由协议BGP的配置
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-sag-route-protocol-bgp --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --router-id 172.XX.XX.1 --local-as 65535 --hold-time 9 --keep-alive 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySagRouteProtocolBgp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the BGP router.

Set the value to an IPv4 address
parameters.help_zh:
BGP路由器ID。

取值格式为IPv4地址格式
parameters.name: router_id

parameters.help_en:
The autonomous system number (ASN) to which the SAG device belongs.

Valid values: 1 to 4294967295
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关设备所属自治系统编号。

取值范围：1~4294967295
parameters.name: local_as

parameters.help_en:
The hold time.

Valid values: 3 to 65535. Unit: seconds.

When the SAG device establishes a peering connection with a peer device, the hold time of both devices must be the same. If the SAG device does not receive a keepalive or update message from the peer device within the hold time, the connection between the BGP peers is closed
parameters.help_zh:
保持时间。

取值范围：3~65535。单位：秒。

在智能接入网关设备和对端设备建立对等体关系时，两端设备要协商Hold Time并保持一致，如果在Hold Time内未收到对端发来的KeepAlive或Update消息，则认为BGP连接中断。
parameters.name: hold_time

parameters.help_en:
The time interval at which keep-alive packets are sent.

Valid values: 0 to 65535. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
存活时间间隔。

取值范围：0~65535。单位：秒
parameters.name: keep_alive
